name: Project XML Sync
description: Compares a project's design with a Project XML exported from another server (e.g. the TEST copy of a trial) and applies the selected differences to this project. Field changes go through Draft Mode; events, mappings, repeating setup, DQ rules, surveys, ASIs, alerts and other settings are applied directly. Every applied change is logged.

project-settings.name: Only allow administrators to apply changes. When unchecked, any user with Project Design & Setup rights can review and apply changes (core REDCap production restrictions still apply).
